task.topic: Among adults hospitalized with COVID-19, what source-reported all-cause mortality data are available for intravenous remdesivir plus standard care compared with placebo or standard care without remdesivir?

pico.comparator: Placebo or standard care without remdesivir for the primary contrast

integrity_checks: Do not substitute values from the target review.
Do not silently relabel a remdesivir-duration comparison as a no-remdesivir comparison.
Do not silently replace an analysis denominator with the randomized denominator.
Preserve a possible overlap with WHO Solidarity as an explicit provenance field; overlap resolution belongs to analysis.

extraction_notes: Extraction records source numbers and metadata only. Effect calculation belongs to the calculator and selection belongs to the analysis task.

candidate_capture_policy.record_scope: For every supplied primary report, capture each source-supported arm-level mortality record that mentions remdesivir. Retain planned remdesivir duration, the actual comparator identity, the analysis population, and follow-up. Do not discard a complete source record merely because later analysis may reject its comparator, duration, overlap, or post-randomization analysis population.

extraction.model_selection_policy: Preserve every source-reported candidate; no study or effect selection occurs in extraction.
extraction.exclusion_concepts: Extraction records source numbers and metadata only. Effect calculation belongs to the calculator and selection belongs to the analysis task.
extraction.evidence_requirements: Transcribe only source-supported data, preserve exact evidence, and do not calculate, pool, choose an analysis record, or infer missing values.
